purpose: Provenance for the explicitly approved H100-to-A40 replacement of the two serialized K16 causal controls

user_authorization.approval_quote: Approve, cross-hardware QA comparison is generally acceptable!
user_authorization.hardware_requirement_quote: Keep in mind that we just need to have enough VRAM for e.g. HLVID at max tiles video =48 etc.
user_authorization.approved_scope: Cancel the wholly unstarted H100 array once and replace it with the same two full-protocol evaluations on the nominal 48-GB-class A40 GRES, serialized at one active task.
user_authorization.interpretation_boundary: Comparisons against the six H100-evaluated trained K16 endpoints are descriptive cross-hardware QA. Latency remains hardware-specific; no trained reference is rerun for hardware matching.

frozen_scientific_protocol.full_protocol_first_question_gate: retained in each real allocation with fail-closed admission, expanded-context checks, and actual OOM detection

cancelled_h100_submission.preexisting_file_role: pre-submission admission check, not a generated QA answer or allocation preflight

replacement_a40_submission.submission_warning: Slurm emitted its advisory 8-CPU-per-GPU ratio warning and explicitly stated there is no penalty; the approved 8-CPU request was preserved.

same_a40_node_relaxation.rationale: Node15 is not part of a scientific identity. Typed A40 nodes 15-18 advertise the nominal GPU_MEM:48 class and shared paths; clearing the node pin retains the same A40 class while removing an unnecessary node15 bottleneck.
same_a40_node_relaxation.precondition: Both replacement elements resolved individually and remained PENDING with zero runtime.
same_a40_node_relaxation.actual_allocation_node_recording: Required from Slurm accounting and the launcher's nvidia-smi line after each task allocates.

typed_scheduler_capacity.capacity_label: nominal 48-GB GPU class, not a claim of 48 GiB runtime-visible memory

completed_full_protocol_reference.protocol: forced-K16, 128 frames, 64 thumbnails, max_tiles_video=48, bfloat16 NVILA
completed_full_protocol_reference.interpretation: This is concrete A40 capacity evidence for the complete frozen input protocol. The near-128G host RSS supports retaining the full 128G host-memory request.

a40_capacity_evidence.new_control_safeguard: Each new policy still executes its own real-allocation first-question preflight and fails closed on OOM or protocol mismatch.
